title: Parcel check
purpose: Shows whether the doorstep camera pictures were judged to hold a parcel.
description: Looks at saved doorstep pictures through the Intelligent Home AI layer and says yes, no or unsure. This page is read-only: it shows the mode, the counts for today and the last 7 days, the last 20 verdicts and recent errors. It never shows or serves a picture.
navigation: Shows whether the add-on is in dry mode or live
Counts the pictures checked today and in the last 7 days
Lists the last 20 verdicts with the camera and the AI that answered
Lists recent errors, such as the AI layer being unreachable
